records.title: Fault-Tolerant Quantum Error Correction Architecture Using Topological Surface Codes in Superconducting Transmon Qubits
records.description: A scalable multi-qubit lattice control method for fault-tolerant syndrome measurements with reduced cross-talk in cryogenic quantum processors.

records.title: Quantum Key Distribution Protocol and Photonic Transmitter for Satellite-to-Ground Free-Space Optical Cryptographic Channels
records.description: Entanglement-based quantum key generation system incorporating adaptive beam steering and atmospheric turbulence compensation for secure satellite communications.

records.title: Low-Power Neuromorphic Edge Computing Accelerator with On-Chip Spiking Neural Network Processing for IoT Sensory Nodes
records.description: Ultra-low power ASIC hardware architecture employing memristive crossbar arrays for asynchronous event-based neuromorphic processing on battery-operated edge devices.

records.title: Post-Quantum Cryptographic Key Encapsulation Mechanism and Secure Hardware Module for Critical Infrastructure Protection
records.description: Lattice-based cryptographic engine resistant to Shor and Grover quantum algorithms, implementing constant-time modular arithmetic for cyber defense.
records.organization: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
